reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

title.narrative: Muti-Purpose Cash Support for Families in Crises, Khartoum

description.narrative:
This is a three-month project, The project aims to provide multi-purpose cash to 2000 households (HHs) consisting of 12,000 individuals from female headed households and people with special needs and poor trapped by war in Khartoum.
The Project main objective can be attained through the following outcomes: Outcome 1: People affected by crisis including female headed households have access to lifesaving integrated protection and assistance appropriate and relevant to their immediate needs. Outcome 2: Humanitarian responses are improved through system-wide quality coordination. SUDO's capacity in managing cash transfers and institutional capacity will be enhanced through training and the provision of communication equipment and digital appliances. SUDO will also enhance its linkage with civil society by supporting and building the capacities of women’s groups and youth volunteers.
